name: typography-terms
title: Typography terms
status: draft 2026-10-28 (owner asked for the first render; style frames: brand/references/studies/typography-terms-style.png)
use_for: Personal and event stories told over the owner's own photos: editorial type in the quiet parts of the photo, words behind people (Vision cut-outs), handwritten asides, and a warm 'terms paper' for data frames.

components.photo: ; cut-out on top:
components.type: .t-title (Inter Tight 900, <i> swaps to Fraunces italic), .t-serif, .t-hand, .t-line, .t-meta, .t-row (spread meta row with .bar), .t-time (with <sup>)
components.objects: .pill (sticker), .chat (message bubble), .block (accent block behind a title), svg.draw with .hand-ink paths
